description: PRESHAKE-Centrifuge modeling of the effect of seismic preshaking on the liquefaction resistance of sands is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). This effect of preshaking history on the liquefaction behavior of sandy soils is documented in this database. This database includes data from two centrifuge experiments performed on both silty and clean sand. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (PDF, CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d38k74x78. Keywords: centrifuge modeling, earthquake engineering, databases, geotechnical engineering , liquefaction. Published 2015-02-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
